query: How should calibration be performed and integrated into clinician workflows: per-class calibration technique, uncertainty thresholds that trigger human review, and metrics to quantify clinical utility (time saved, adjudication rate)?

response.query: How should calibration be performed and integrated into clinician workflows: per-class calibration technique, uncertainty thresholds that trigger human review, and metrics to quantify clinical utility (time saved, adjudication rate)?
response.answer: Calibration should use per-class techniques, set uncertainty thresholds for human review, and measure clinical utility via time saved and adjudication rate. This ensures accurate model performance and efficient workflow integration.
